## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Motivation / Problem Statement
What problem does this solve for students or educators? (e.g. "I find it hard to export quiz results to Notion...")

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe how you imagine this feature working in the frontend or backend.

## 📋 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📎 Additional Context
Add any mockups, API references, or relevant links here.
